mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nickname_history (user_key, group_id, old_nickname, new_nickname, changed_by) VALUES (#{userKey}, #{groupId}, #{oldNickname}, #{newNickname}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id, h.user_key, h.group_id, h.old_nickname, h.new_nickname, h.changed_by, h.created_at, COALESCE(cm.nickname, cu.nickname) AS changed_by_name FROM nickname_history h LEFT JOIN group_member cm ON cm.group_id = h.group_id AND cm.user_key = h.changed_by LEFT JOIN `user` cu ON cu.user_key = h.changed_by WHERE h.group_id = #{groupId} AND h.user_key = #{userKey} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT h.history_id, h.user_key, h.group_id, g.name AS group_name, h.old_nickname, h.new_nickname, h.changed_by, h.created_at, CASE WHEN h.group_id IS NULL THEN cu.nickname ELSE COALESCE(cm.nickname, cu.nickname) END AS changed_by_name FROM nickname_history h LEFT JOIN `group` g ON g.group_id = h.group_id LEFT JOIN group_member cm ON cm.group_id = h.group_id AND cm.user_key = h.changed_by LEFT JOIN `user` cu ON cu.user_key = h.changed_by WHERE h.user_key = #{userKey} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT 200
